data.title: Alibaba answers Meta’s AI challenge with new laptop-ready model
data.description: Alibaba launched a laptop-ready AI model and released the weights of its most powerful Qwen model, escalating its rivalry with Meta in open-weight AI.
data.author: Arjun Kharpal
